about: The shapes one lead session's week of ledger showed, in placeholder words: ten identical automated nudges among four real fleet prompts; three messages stopped and resent seconds later (identical, edited at the end, extended); promises reported on and then left to go stale while their work landed later; an item waiting on the person; bare answers to the agent's numbered questions. Times are seconds from the start.
nudge: [fleet] A worker finished or needs you — run fleet-inbox to see what changed, then continue (dispatch the next step, merge, or unblock). Automated nudge; no need to reply to it.

events.prompt: review the acme-api export worker's PR and merge it when both CI legs are green

events.answer: Reviewed. I'll merge and deploy #12 and #13 when CI passes.
promises: merge and deploy #12 and #13 when CI passes

events.answer: #12 merged and deployed; #13 still awaiting CI.

events.fleet: [fleet] This request comes from another agent (toolbox/master). Which branch holds the scratch fixtures?

events.answer: The scratch fixtures are on the scratch branch.

events.prompt: rename the toolbox flag to --dry and update every caller in the repo please
rename the toolbox flag to --dry and update every caller in the repo pls
look at the billing-svc logs and say why the retry loops

events.answer: The retry loops because the token expires mid-request.

events.prompt: merge the acme-web sidebar PR once the suite passes and tell me
merge the acme-web sidebar PR once the suite passes and tell me

events.answer: Fixed again; the stuck prompt was the cause.

events.prompt: assemble the release screenshots and run the size check

events.answer: Assembly waits on you taking the screenshots; I will assemble them once they are in.
verdict: Assembly waits on the user taking the screenshots first.

events.prompt: pick a deploy target for the export

events.answer:
Two options:
1. acme-api staging
2. acme-web preview
Which one?

events.prompt: which node version does the toolbox CI use?
what is the scratch branch for

events.answer: Both landed: #13 merged and deployed after #12. The release screenshots still waits on your screenshots.
